fusions.name: Shed Them All
fusions.desc: Sweeps the flat of the blade in a full circle that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Mind Like Water
fusions.desc: A cut that deals 28 damage, ignores resistances, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Damped] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Runoff
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Bob Under, Come Up
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
